scope: Theorem 3.2 (Recursive simultaneous labeling) of the manuscript “Turn-Based Stochastic Mean-Payoff Games in Deterministic Quasipolynomial Time” (preprints/Turn-Based-Stochastic-Mean-Payoff-Games-in-Deterministic-Quasipolynomial-Time-October-5-2026/stochastic-mean-payoff-games.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 104 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 77e967a1db5965db), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let F : Rn → Rn satisfy Equation (3.1). There is a terminating deterministic procedure L(A, D, a, b), using exact evaluations of ⌊F(t)⌋ for t ∈ Zn and integer and rational arithmetic, with the following guarantee. For every input as in Equation (3.2) and Definition 3.1, its output ℓ ∈ {+, −}n satisfies yi ≥ Ai + D − P =⇒ ℓi = + for every plus witness y, zi ≤ Ai + P =⇒ ℓi = − for every minus witness z.
